title: jq lab
description: Write and fix jq filters against JSON inputs, see every output and which expected outputs pass.
needs: one or more jq parts ({filter}) and one or more json parts (any JSON data)
query: [.messages[] ~ {kind: "jq"}] as $filters | [.messages[] ~ {kind: "json"}] as $inputs | [.messages[] ~ {kind: "jq-expected"}] as $expected | ($filters | length) > 0 and ($inputs | length) > 0
